# AHLAMY

> AHLAMY is an AI-assisted customer communication platform for businesses, helping organize customer enquiries, support conversations, and booking workflows.

## Product
AHLAMY serves businesses across sectors where customer communication and service workflows matter, including property management, hospitality, e-commerce, travel, transport and rental, education, maintenance, and professional services.

Depending on configuration and enabled features, AHLAMY can support:
- AI-assisted replies to customer enquiries.
- Organizing incoming customer conversations.
- Customer support workflows.
- Booking and service request workflows.
- Multilingual business communication.

AHLAMY is built in Algeria for businesses worldwide.

## Links
- Website: https://ahlamy-ai.github.io/
- Application: https://ahlamy-ai.github.io/app/

## Important
Feature availability depends on configuration and enabled integrations. Contact AHLAMY to discuss suitability for a specific business workflow.
